question: 涨价前我买了100股九菱科技和66股泉为科技，总共赚了多少钱？

steps.description: Locate 九菱科技 in the chart and read its current price value
Locate 九菱科技 in the chart and read its price change value
Multiply 100 shares by the price change from step_2 to get 九菱科技 profit
Locate 泉为科技 in the chart and read its current price value
Locate 泉为科技 in the chart and read its price change value
Multiply 66 shares by the price change from step_5 to get 泉为科技 profit
Add the profits from step_3 and step_6 to get total profit
